## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format -- --check` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` passes (coverage thresholds met)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or `.env` values committed
- [ ] User-supplied input is validated/sanitized/escaped (if this touches the form or API)
- [ ] CSP / security headers updated if a new third-party script, frame, or endpoint was added
- [ ] Docs/ADRs updated if behavior or an architectural decision changed
- [ ] Accessibility considered for any UI change (labels, focus, contrast, keyboard)
